Lately, it feels like the world is teetering on the edge of collapse. Every news report, every rustle of leaves outside – it all points to an impending catastrophe, like a void is about to swallow everything whole. It's been going on for about two months now. It’s unsettling, especially during a wedding shoot when I need to focus.

My husband tries to reassure me, but he just doesn't understand the urgency of it all. I’ve been feeling so intensely, like everything is heightened. My thoughts race, and I get these bursts of energy where I feel like I could work for days without sleep, conceptualizing entire photo series in a single night. There’s a buzzing in my head, a sense of immense creativity and purpose, but then the dread creeps back in about the world ending.
